title: Watch scientists decipher burned scrolls without unrolling them
title_zh: 科学家破解未展开的烧毁卷轴
abstract: By making and burning their own papyrus, researchers have come up with a method that might help to read glowing text from unopened scrolls from Herculaneum.
abstract_zh: 通过自制并烧毁纸莎草，研究人员提出了一种可能帮助读取赫库兰尼姆未展开卷轴中发光文字的方法。
snippet: By making and burning their own papyrus, researchers have come up with a method that might help to read glowing text from unopened scrolls from Herculaneum.
